en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large three-story masonry school building with many tall windows and a central entrance risalit. The façade bears a small pediment and decorative clock or emblem. In front, a street runs along the building with a railing and some trees; a woman pushes a small child in a stroller and a few children stand nearby. At the top of the card is printed German text identifying the location as Geyer in the Erzgebirge region and specifying that the building is a Bürgerschule (civic school).
